title: Add a divide() helper to the math utils
description: Add a divide(a, b) helper alongside the existing add() utility so callers stop hand-rolling division.
acceptance_criteria: divide(a, b) returns the quotient of a and b
the helper is exported from src/math.ts
story_context: Seed story for the Review Forge end-to-end harness: a tiny math helper whose happy path works but whose zero-divisor and non-numeric edges are unguarded, so the reviewers and the failure router all have something real to chew on.
